checks.message: Provisional boundary is disclosed and excluded from statutory claims; recalculate when official geometry arrives.
AgentPassport, MissionContract and Observation fields are explicit; dispatch is skill-level only.
Geofence, no-fly, human approval, emergency stop, privacy and energy gates are represented and tested.

Protocol JZ-URBAN-HARNESS-EVAL-v1 fixes seed, task-manifest hash, 100/100 denominator, zero exclusions and success definition; Harness and both baselines have replayable offline traces, while the single-LLM entry is explicitly a deterministic surrogate.
Bilingual-facing visual page is local, static and free of remote resources or active scripts.
Proposal includes source, standard, depth, data and metric references and all required design sections.
Official validator, spatial review and visual review are run again after any final file change.
Both baseline policies use the frozen manifest and include task results, dispatch calls, observations, environment metadata and checksums.

note: All three runs are offline synthetic; the single-LLM baseline is a deterministic policy surrogate and not a live-model performance claim. Minor provisional-boundary warnings remain intentionally disclosed.
